pattern: ^SELECT .+ FROM Semesters AS T1 JOIN \(\s*(?P<subquery>SELECT .+ FROM\w+ .* )\s*ON T1\.semester_id = (?P<student_enrolment_id>\w+)\.student_enrolment_id\s*ORDER BY num_students DESC LIMIT 1
correction: Join the Student_Enrolment table directly to Semesters, group by semester_id, order by total student count and limit the result to one.

metadata.description: This rule identifies queries that join a subquery with Semesters table using student enrollment ID, instead of directly joining the Student_Enrolment table and grouping by semester_id.
